decision.rationale: The affected tests prove synthetic artifact/continuity capture and settings restoration, not the host wall clock. Give their real reservation logic coherent controlled time; independently test rejection of unsafe reservation time. This removes ambient time as an unrelated prerequisite without disabling admission.

Keep workflow deadline creation/comparison and routing reservation time in a coherent synthetic epoch. Use module-local clock replacements or equivalent narrow test injection; do not mutate the shared stdlib time module, SDK/logging clock, event-loop monotonic clock or unrelated tests.

Exercise real reserve_decision with controlled prior reservation time and a backward jump exceeding five seconds; assert DECISION_ADMISSION_CLOCK and no added reservation. Retain shared-parent replay, configuration, quota and expiry assertions.

Bound synthetic time progression and waits so fixture isolation cannot introduce unbounded admission waiting. No production tolerance, runtime clock, retry, dependency, engine or platform change is authorized by this decision.
